Our Story

GachaGang started in 2024 with a simple mission: bring back the golden era of anime and pop culture. We grew up watching Cowboy Bebop on late-night TV, collecting Akira posters, and hunting for that rare Godzilla figure.

Today, we scour the globe to find the best merchandise from the 80s and 90s - the era that defined anime for generations. Every product in our store is officially licensed and authentic.

Join the Gang. See you space cowboy.
